question: Do the six exact shared weight-interface nominations correspond to exercised causal paths for both commands, and are the three nominated heads distributive enough for a greedy combination?
eligibility: The prefix-preserved dual-command capability result must issue its exact all-32-row license. Otherwise do not open these causal outcomes.

frozen_design.native_capture: In one forward over all 128 exact endpoints, capture the concatenated pre-c_proj head outputs at layers 9, 11, and 15 and both native answer margins.
frozen_design.counterfactual_pairing: For temporal swaps, pair cells differing only in the temporal bit; for is-was swaps, pair cells differing only in the is-was bit. At the token immediately preceding that role's answer, replace either the complete 1152-dimensional pre-c_proj vector or only the nominated 128-dimensional head slice with its paired donor value.
frozen_design.interventions: For each role run the three singleton-head swaps, three complete-parent-module swaps, and one simultaneous three-head swap. Record effects on both role margins for every row/cell; do not select rows, directions, templates, or sites.
frozen_design.metrics: Against the native paired-cell margin difference g and patched change e, report signed recovery <e,g>/<g,g>, cosine, direction agreement, and relative residual ||e-g||/||g|| by role/template/phase. Report non-target effect relative to target gold norm. For each layer report singleton-head signed recovery divided by its parent-module signed recovery. For the simultaneous head set report ||e_union-sum(e_h)||/||e_union|| and union recovery versus the best singleton.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_capture_closure: All authorities, license, pairing involutions, head slices, capture replays, finite metrics, model configuration, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_each_command_has_a_material_compl: For each role, at least one parent module has signed recovery >=.50, direction agreement >=.75, and cosine >=.50 in both FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_c_a_nominated_head_accounts_for_its: For each role, at least one nominated head has signed recovery >=.25, >=.50 of its corresponding module recovery, direction agreement >=.75, and cosine >=.50 in both phases.
predictions.pred_d_three_head_union_is_distributive_: For both roles and phases, union-versus-sum relative error is <=.25 and union signed recovery is at least the best singleton recovery minus .05.
predictions.pred_e_task_typed_selectivity_survives_s: For every admitted role/phase head, absolute non-target effect is <=.25 of target gold norm; the later is-was intervention changes the earlier temporal margin by <=1e-5.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/E identifies shared physical weight interfaces that causally carry distinct task-typed states. D additionally licenses the three-head greedy combination. If B passes but C fails, the weight nomination localizes only a parent module. If D fails, use interaction-aware subsets rather than greedy combination. If E fails, call the route shared and entangled, not selective. This experiment does not yet claim final task-program additivity.
